_comment: LoopSmith Insight — the complete project backlog, defined upfront. Source of truth for the GitHub Project board; `docs/insight-backlog.py sync` creates/updates issues from it. Epics are TRACKING issues (label: epic) and are never run by the loop. Stories carry `sdlc:goal` and ARE the loop's unit of work — one story = one worktree/branch/PR. Tasks are the checklist inside a story body; they become that goal's done_when, and LoopSmith's Plan phase expands them into real steps. Deliberately NOT separate issues: the loop ignores non-goal issues, so 200 task issues would be noise.

epics.title: Foundation — insight/ package, licence, CI boundary
epics.why: The licence must be the first commit (spec §1.1 rule 4), and the plugin/product boundary must be test-enforced before any code can blur it.

stories.done_when: insight/LICENSE exists (BUSL-style, source-available); root README states the two-licence boundary; insight/ file headers carry the marker; the plugin's MIT LICENSE is untouched
tasks: Write insight/LICENSE with change-date and additional-use grant
Add a 'Licensing' section to the root README naming both licences and the folder boundary
Add the licence header line to a template used by all insight/ source files
Test: any .py under insight/ without the header fails

stories.title: insight/ package skeleton + pyproject
stories.done_when: insight/ has pyproject.toml declaring duckdb; `pip install -e insight/` works; `python -m insight --help` prints usage; VERSION file independent of plugin.json
tasks: Create insight/{ingest,metrics,gaps,dash,tests}/ with __init__ where needed
pyproject.toml with duckdb pinned, console_script entry point
insight/VERSION starting at 0.1.0
__main__.py with an argparse skeleton (ingest | dash | gaps)

stories.title: Separate CI job and coverage gate
stories.done_when: CI has an insight job; insight/ is EXCLUDED from the plugin's --cov-fail-under=85 denominator; an insight test failure fails only the insight job
tasks: Add an insight job to .github/workflows/ci.yml with its own deps install
Confirm the plugin's pytest invocation ignores insight/ (--ignore or testpaths)
Set insight's own coverage floor
Verify by mutation: break an insight test, confirm the plugin job still passes

stories.title: Import-boundary guard, both directions
stories.done_when: A test fails if anything under skills/ or hooks/ imports insight, OR anything under insight/ imports from skills/hooks as a Python module; the contract is file formats only (spec §1.1 rule 1)
tasks: Write the AST/grep-based boundary scan, modelled on tests/test_self_contained.py
Assert both directions independently with distinct messages
Prove by mutation: add a violating import in each direction, confirm each fails
Document the allowed coupling (reading files by path) in the test docstring

epics.title: Ingest — collectors, readers, store bootstrap
epics.why: Everything downstream reads the store. The collector adapter (spec §B.3.1) is the primary Class-1 interface and the reason 25 metrics need no instrumentation.

stories.title: DuckDB store bootstrap and schema
stories.done_when: `insight ingest` creates the 5-table star schema (dim_project, dim_actor, fact_goal, fact_event, fact_handoff) idempotently; reliability_class and phase_trace_completeness columns exist; re-running never duplicates rows
tasks: DDL for the five tables per spec §B.3
Idempotent create-or-migrate on open
Test: open twice, assert no duplicate schema objects

stories.title: Collector adapter keyed on schema string
stories.done_when: One adapter ingests alignment-collect/v1, pipeline card JSON, and discovery-scan output, routed by their `schema` field; an unknown schema is recorded and skipped, never fatal; degraded[] codes land in the store
tasks: Adapter registry keyed on the schema string
Run each collector as a subprocess, capture stdout JSON
Persist the pack with its window and degraded[] codes
Test: an unknown schema is skipped with a recorded reason
Test: a collector that exits non-zero degrades, never crashes ingest

stories.title: Ledger reader — entries and events streams
stories.done_when: Reads the union of ledger/entries/*.jsonl and ledger/events/*.jsonl oldest-first; a malformed line is skipped not fatal; also reads .sdlc/events/*.jsonl when telemetry.share is off
tasks: Read both streams, union, sort by (ts, actor, seq)
Tolerate malformed lines exactly as ledger.read_all does
Fall back to the local .sdlc/events/ path
Test with a fixture ledger containing a corrupt line

stories.title: Artifact reader — goals, plans, slices, config
stories.done_when: Goal frontmatter (id/title/lane/done_when/status/source/verify_command), *.slices.json, and config.json land in the store; a goal missing a field records the absence rather than guessing
tasks: Frontmatter parse reusing the kit's field names
slices.json parse for declared files and sizes
config.json snapshot into dim_project for the adoption metric
Test: a goal with no done_when is recorded as absent, not defaulted

stories.title: Git facts reader
stories.done_when: Commits, merges, first-commit-to-merge lead time land in the store for a configurable window; matches velocity.py's measurement for the same window
tasks: git log readers for commits and merges
Lead-time derivation per branch/PR
Cross-check against velocity.py measure for the same window in a test

stories.title: GitHub reader (optional, degrades)
stories.done_when: With gh available, PR review timings and check outcomes land; without gh or without auth, ingest completes and records the degradation — never fails
tasks: gh pr list/view readers for review + check data

stories.title: Incremental resume and idempotence
stories.done_when: Ingest stores max(seq) per (project, actor, stream) reusing the ledger's own cursor; running ingest twice produces identical row counts; a partial run resumes without gaps or duplicates
tasks: Watermark table keyed on (project, actor, stream)
Resume from watermark on the next run
Test: ingest twice, assert identical counts
Test: interrupt mid-run, resume, assert no gap and no duplicate

epics.title: Gap engine — five typed classes, no LLM in the finding path
epics.why: Gaps are what turn metrics into action. Typed rules keep them testable and defensible.

stories.title: Gap rule format and severity vocabulary
stories.done_when: A gap rule is a .sql plus metadata returning {class, severity, evidence rows, metric moved, action}; severity uses pipeline.py's PASS/WARN/FAIL/ABSENT ordering; a rule with no evidence query is rejected
tasks: Rule format and loader
Severity vocabulary shared with the metric layer
Test: a rule returning a finding with no evidence rows fails

stories.title: Coverage gap class
stories.done_when: Fires on an ABSENT applicable gate, a NO-COMMAND verify, a missing review input, and any collector degraded[] code; each finding names which code and which goals
tasks: Rules for each coverage source
Consume degraded[] codes directly per spec §B.3.1
Regression test phrased as the invariant: absent must never render as pass

stories.title: Definition gap class
stories.done_when: Fires on a goal with no done_when, no plan artifact, or no verify command; evidence names the goals and the missing field
tasks: Rules per missing field
Fixture with each defect
Assert no false positive on a complete goal

stories.title: Threshold gap class with derived baselines
stories.done_when: Fires when a metric crosses its OWN trailing p85; no hardcoded constants anywhere in the rules; evidence shows the series, the baseline, and the breach
tasks: Trailing-baseline helper
Rules referencing it, never a literal
Test: a project with a slow-but-stable series produces no gap
Grep test: no numeric literal thresholds in gaps/

stories.title: Consistency gap class
stories.done_when: Fires on ledger-done vs PR-open, verify-passed-but-no-test-changed (alignment-collect d2), and slices-declared vs files-touched (d1); evidence shows both records side by side
tasks: Rule per disagreement pair
Source both sides in the evidence output
Fixture per rule

stories.title: Debt gap class
stories.done_when: Fires on rising discovery-scan inventory and unanswered knowledge/gaps.md queries; evidence carries file, count, and trend
tasks: Rules over the scan snapshots
Trend derivation
